blurb: Award-Winning Independent Theatre In TorontoCoal Mine Theatre is an award-winning independent theatre company in Toronto, producing bold contemporary plays, acclaimed revivals, and some of the city’s most talked-about live theatre. In our intimate 100-seat venue, every seat is close to the action and every performance feels personal.
